$comment: THE list of work types — the only place a type is defined. A type is at once a branch prefix (<type>/<description>), a Conventional Commit and PR-title type, and a PR label. release: the bump a commit of that type triggers (minor | patch; `!` or a BREAKING CHANGE footer makes any type major). color: its label's color (description "Changes for '<type>' branches"). Key order is precedence: the release PR's title takes the first type among the released commits (scripts/release-title.mjs), so keep the minor types first. Read by commitlint.config.mjs (hook + PR check), scripts/release-title.mjs, actions/pr-check and actions/auto-pr. config/cliff.toml applies the same bumps (feat minor, the rest patch). This repo uses `refact`, never `refactor`.
